Get started with Braintrust
Copy page Copy page
Copy page Copy page
Braintrust is the active observability platform for instrumenting, understanding, and improving agents. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them. To get started, create a Braintrust account .
​
Quickstarts
Log your first trace
Integrate with AI providers and frameworks to send traces to Braintrust
Run your first eval
Measure and improve AI application quality with playgrounds and evals
Connect your coding agent
Install the bt CLI to set up, instrument, and run Braintrust with your coding agent
Start your first Loop thread
Ask Braintrust’s AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
​
Workflow
Follow Braintrust’s structured workflow to build, evaluate, and improve AI applications:
Instrument
Capture traces from your AI application
Observe
Analyze logs and identify patterns
Annotate
Add human feedback and build datasets
Evaluate
Test changes with experiments
Deploy
Ship changes and monitor production
Admin
Manage organizations, projects, and access control
